items.author: jiyimeta
items.body:
## What problem does this solve?

`skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/review-package` runs **every** git command against the current working directory — `git rev-parse`, `git log`, `git diff`, `git rev-list` are all invoked as bare `git` with no `-C`. So the script only works when the orchestrator's cwd already *is* the target repository.

In worktree-based SDD flows that isn't the case. The driver session commonly stays in the main checkout while implementation happens in a worktree subdirectory (e.g. `.../.claude/worktrees/<task>`), so the only way to point the script at the right re
items.title: subagent-driven-development: review-package operates on $PWD, forcing an un-allowlistable "cd <repo> ; review-package" compound
